Name: Recolor Decorative Houseplants
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[font=Arial][size=4][u][b]Features and Options:[/b][/u]

This mod adds 19 houseplants with the Content Patcher to decorate your Stardew Valley home in a variety of sizes and colors. [font=Arial][size=4]Basically, I took my favorite pots from my previous mod, created a variety of tall houseplants and then I added an Alternative Textures pack to make it easier to choose a specific plant. Now you have the freedom to change the color of the decorative pot and it won't clutter up the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer as much. (I should have done that with my first mod, but I didn't realize how to do it at the time).[/size][/font]

Overall, you will have over 80 houseplants that can be placed indoors or outdoors and allows you to have numerous options for just about any color palette, which can be changed via the Paint Bucket tool purchased from Robin. The Content Patcher pack and Alternative Textures pack are in the same download folder for your convenience. All you have to do is unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. Please note: two of the plants do NOT have Alternative Textures. Also, I wanted slightly taller houseplants, so most of these are 16x48 pixels instead of 16x32. They can be found under the "Decor/Houseplant" section of the Furniture Catalog or Happy Home Designer.

[u][b]Installation and Usage:[/b][/u][u][b]

[/b][/u][/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Install the latest verson of SMAPI[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿. If you'd like to change the texture of the placed item, you can use the Paint Bucket tool on it. This tool is purchasable from Robin.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=4][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ are not required, but I do recommend them. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=4]I also recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to make life much easier.[/size][/font]
[/list]
